definitions.gloss: excretion; elimination of waste from the body
definitions.explanation: The biological process of expelling waste products such as urine and feces from the body. Used in medical, biological, and caregiving contexts.

examples.japanese: {排泄|はいせつ}の{介助|かいじょ}をする。
{赤|あか}ちゃんの{排泄|はいせつ}リズムを{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: I'm keeping track of the baby's excretion patterns.

examples.japanese: {腎臓|じんぞう}は{体内|たいない}の{老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排泄|はいせつ}する{重要|じゅうよう}な{臓器|ぞうき}だ。
examples.english: The kidneys are vital organs that excrete waste products from the body.

notes: Composed of {排|はい} (expel, discharge) + {泄|せつ} (leak, excrete). A formal/technical term used in medical and caregiving contexts rather than everyday conversation. Common collocations: {排泄|はいせつ}する (to excrete), {排泄|はいせつ}{物|ぶつ} (excrement), {排泄|はいせつ}{介助|かいじょ} (toileting assistance), {排泄|はいせつ}{障害|しょうがい} (excretory disorder). In nursing care ({介護|かいご}), {排泄|はいせつ}ケア (excretion care) is one of the fundamental caregiving skills. The more colloquial way to discuss going to the bathroom is トイレに{行|い}く or {用|よう}を{足|た}す.
